M1.title: Adafruit 1201 coin ERM and linked specification
M1.use: Rated 3 V actuator and running-current data. No measured winding DCR, inductance or spin-up profile for the selected actual sample.

B1.title: Adafruit protected 3.7 V, 1200 mAh pack 258
B1.use: Single-cell capacity, 4.2 V charge endpoint, charge at 500 mA or less and two-wire factory connector. Obtain current cell-lot charge-temperature and protection specifications.

AXP.title: X-Powers AXP2101 switch-charger datasheet linked by board vendor
AXP.use: VBUS input range, TS current/thermistor table, register 0x50 TS configuration, charge conditions and hardware power-key behavior. Confirm PMIC customization and board stuffing.

ESP.title: Espressif ESP32-S3 datasheet
ESP.use: Recommended 3.0 to 3.6 V operating range and chip reset requirements. Bench the assembled system at the MCU supply.

ESPREF.title: Espressif ESP32-S3 schematic checklist
ESPREF.use: PCB power, RF, USB, decoupling and reset design checks.

UM10204.title: NXP UM10204, I2C-bus specification and user manual, Rev 7.0
UM10204.use: Fast-mode 30 to 70 percent rise limit 300 ns and 0.4 V sink capability condition at 3 mA for VDD greater than 2 V.

TYPEC.title: USB-IF, USB Type-C Cable and Connector Specification
TYPEC.use: CC resistor implementation, advertised-current detection bands and orientation. Confirm applicable edition in release review.

USB2.title: USB-IF USB 2.0 specification and ECNs
USB2.use: Legacy default-power host cases, full-speed signaling. Compare against actual configuration descriptor, source advertisement, suspend behavior and applicable ECNs.

DRV.title: Texas Instruments DRV2605L datasheet
DRV.use: Open-loop ERM operation and overdrive clamp; the ROM waveform and silicon output impedance are outside these decks.

SP1.title: Waveshare kit and speaker specification
SP1.use: Reference configuration selects 6 ohm, 1 W kit speaker. Confirm received speaker and revision.

SW1.title: Omron B3F switch family
SW1.use: Switch family for SW1 B3F-1002-G. Observe normally open dry contact and actual wire/termination resistance.

BOARD.title: Rev F sourcing register and wiring
BOARD.use: Harnesses W1, W2, W3, selected board/pack/speaker, optional A3 and M1. Electrical dynamic assumptions and acceptance margins are identified in the report.

FW.title: Thai Waters firmware
FW.use: 400 kHz I2C, 4.2 V target, 300 mA current, 1/4 second key holds. See adjacent Sound.cpp and Rumble.cpp for ES8311 volume and DRV2605L programming.
